subject: general
question: Which of the following crops requires maximum water per hectare for production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sugarcane.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sugarcane crops** needs maximum water per hectare.
 
• The crop water need or crop evapotranspiration consists of transpiration by the plant and evaporation from the soil and plant surface.
 
• The water need of a crop thus consists of transpiration plus evaporation.
 
• Therefore, the crop water need is also called **"evapotranspiration".**
